text:
marcus_cs: Quick share — I put together a concise runbook for onboarding high-throughput customers focused on caching, batching, and streaming. Posting here for feedback and to use as the canonical customer-facing playbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboard-cache-batch-stream
emily_cs: Nice. Can you drop the TL;DR here so I can paste into the kickoff doc?
marcus_cs: TL;DR — 1) identify hot endpoints (top token users) 2) enable prefix/KV caching for stable prompts 3) configure batching with a small max wait (50-250ms) depending on latency SLO 4) prefer streaming for interactive UX + fallback to non-streaming for batch jobs 5) capture prompts & evaluate regen rate after 48h
sam_se: +1. Also call out recommended model profiles by workload. For high QPS recommend pinned small-llm-quant (4bit) for embeddings/short completion, larger pinned for quality-sensitive paths.
leo_sre: Ops note: when you enable prefix caching make sure the KV store persists across node restarts. We use Redis with AOF for customers on Dedicated. Example redis conf we send:
```
# redis.conf snippet
appendonly yes
save 900 1
maxmemory 4gb
maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
```
marcus_cs: Good ops detail. Also include the sample API route config we want customers to apply. Example:
```
# route config
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "caching": { "type": "prefix", "ttl_seconds": 30 },
  "batching": { "enabled": true, "max_wait_ms": 100, "max_batch_tokens": 2048 },
  "stream": true
}
```
emily_cs: For enablement: would you prefer a 45-min workshop + follow-up 1:1? I can gather prompt samples and run a live sim.
nisha_pm: For renewal risk tracking: capture these signals in the account health row — 7-day error rate, 7-day token spend variance, P50/P95 latency, number of fallback events (stream->non-stream). We should flag if token spend drops >30% week-over-week after onboarding.
marcus_cs: Great. Add short survey link to capture qualitative feedback post-workshop. Text to send: "How did the model behavior match your expectations? Any prompts that consistently required retries?" Keep it 3 questions.
emily_cs: I'll schedule the workshop. @onboarding-bot please open ticket for access to their S3 logs and test credentials.
onboarding-bot: Ticket created: ONB-402 — "ACME corp logs + workshop scheduling" assigned to emily_cs
sam_se: Also adding a quick SDK snippet for streaming enablement that we can paste into the onboarding repo:
```
// JS client streaming example
const resp = await client.stream.complete({ model: "redwood-std-1", input: prompt });
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```
leo_sre: Alerting thresholds we recommend in the runbook:
- P95 latency > 800ms -> page on-call
- Error rate > 1% sustained 10m -> trigger incident playbook
- KV miss rate > 20% -> review cache keys
Also include a short runbook step: rotate API keys via console and verify regen on 2 test requests.
nisha_pm: For enablement coordination, suggestion: 1) workshop, 2) 2-week health check, 3) 30-day cost/quality review. Add renewal touchpoints at 60/30 days before contract end.
marcus_cs: I'll update the runbook with these checkpoints. Also adding a suggested email template to capture feedback after the 2-week health check.
emily_cs: Sending workshop invite and I'll collect sample prompts + expected outputs. Will attach to ONB-402. :thumbsup:
marcus_cs: Awesome — once we run one live, we'll iterate the runbook and publish to the docs portal as "customer onboarding: caching & batching guidance". Marking this thread canonical for now.
emily_cs: ack
